messages:
nina_sales: Hey deal-desk — need quick approval for a non-standard pay schedule for ApolloWorks pilot -> prod. Customer requests Net120 on remaining invoices plus an annual upfront split across milestones. Quick facts: 3yr commit, $360k ARR, they want 30% cash upfront, then yearly invoices with Net120, plus request escrow for the year-1 prepaid portion. Can we approve? CC @jess_dealdesk @omar_finance

jess_dealdesk: Can you confirm the requested discount and why they need Net120? Our standard for multi-year is usually upfront or Net30/60. We can consider annual upfront + extended terms on the remainder with conditions (credit check / fee). Need finance + legal sign-off.

omar_finance: Net120 materially raises DSO. If they pay 30% upfront now, remainder Net120 across years is possible but recommend one of: 1) move remainder to Net90, 2) require escrow/parent guarantee, or 3) add a financing fee for extended terms. Also need billing entity + PO cadence for revenue recognition. Please attach expected PO timing.

sam_legal: Escrow is permitted but we need: (a) chosen escrow agent, (b) explicit SOW milestones tied to releases, and (c) KYC on the buying entity. Add payment default interest clause (standard: interest after 90 days). Avoid open-ended Net120 in the first year without guarantees.

lara_cs: Customer note: this is a public-sector-ish procurement org — their AP team typically pays on Net90-120 after PO issuance. They will provide a PO but need the flexibility. They're open to escrow and asked if a small onboarding discount is available if we accept Net120.

jess_dealdesk: Proposed counter from DD: 30% upfront (due on signature), then 40% at month 12 (Net90 invoice), final 30% split annually Net90 thereafter. Offer 5% multi-year discount if they commit 3 years and accept annual invoicing (not Net120). If they insist on Net120, add 1.5% financing fee on outstanding balance. Need finance + legal ack to proceed.

omar_finance: I can provisionally approve the counter (30/40/30 with Net90) and 5% if billed annually and prepay accepted. If they insist on Net120, require escrow or a 1.5% fee. I'll sign off once KYC/PO cadence is attached and sales updates SFDC with payment schedule.

michael_cso: Security note: escrow docs ok but ensure no customer-sensitive keys or data are placed in escrow. If customer asks for Private deployment or KMS access, that changes contract and billing; escalate if that comes up.

nina_sales: Thanks — I'll send the counter and include the PO timing + KYC request. Can deal-desk add an approval tag so finance/legal can track? Also confirm which clause to use for escrow agent selection in the contract template.

jess_dealdesk: Use approval tag DD-NET-EXT-3YR. I'll attach the escrow clause template and mark the contract for legal review. Once we receive PO + KYC, Omar will finalize finance approval.

invoices-bot: Draft invoice created: INV-2026-0047 for 30% upfront. Status=waiting_for_approval. Link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0047

nina_sales: Great — sending to customer now. Will update thread with their response (PO / escrow agent). :thumbsup:

jess_dealdesk: adding note — if customer accepts the 5% 3yr discount, confirm in SFDC with "3YR-ANNUAL-PREPAY" on the billing terms field.

omar_finance: final: Approve conditional on PO + KYC and that escrow agent is one of our approved list. If any deviation, escalate to CFO.

nina_sales: Understood. Thanks everyone.
